title: IBPS PO
content_provenance: Original practice items authored from the public IBPS PO syllabus. Not a capture of past exam questions.

items.stem: A sum of Rs. 5,000 is invested at simple interest for 3 years at an annual rate of 8%. What total amount is received at the end of 3 years?
items.explanation: Simple interest = Principal x Rate x Time / 100 = 5000 x 8 x 3 / 100 = Rs. 1,200. Total amount = 5000 + 1200 = Rs. 6,200.

items.stem: The average age of 5 students in a class is 16 years. When one more student joins, the average becomes 17 years. What is the age of the new student?
items.explanation: Total age of 5 students = 5 x 16 = 80. Total of 6 students = 6 x 17 = 102. The new student's age = 102 - 80 = 22 years.

items.stem: A shopkeeper marks an item 40% above cost price, then allows a 20% discount on the marked price. What is his overall profit percentage?
items.explanation: Let cost = 100. Marked price = 140. Selling price after 20% discount = 140 x 0.8 = 112. Profit = 12, so the profit percentage is 12%.

items.stem: Two trains of lengths 180 m and 120 m run in the same direction at 72 km/hr and 54 km/hr. How long do they take to cross each other?
items.explanation: Relative speed = 72 - 54 = 18 km/hr = 18 x 5/18 = 5 m/s. Total length = 180 + 120 = 300 m. Time = 300 / 5 = 60 seconds.

items.stem: The compound interest on a sum for 2 years at 10% per annum, compounded annually, is Rs. 1,050. What is the principal amount?
items.explanation: Amount = P x (1.1)^2 = 1.21P. Compound interest = 1.21P - P = 0.21P = 1050, so P = 1050 / 0.21 = Rs. 5,000.

items.stem: If 15% of a number is 45, what is 30% of that same number?
items.explanation: 15% of the number is 45, so the number = 45 / 0.15 = 300. Then 30% of 300 = 90.

items.stem: The ratio of the ages of A and B is 3 to 5. If B is 10 years older than A, what is A's present age?
items.explanation: Let A = 3x and B = 5x. Then 5x - 3x = 2x = 10, so x = 5 and A's age is 3 x 5 = 15 years.

items.stem: A can finish a piece of work in 12 days and B can finish the same work in 15 days. Working together, how many days will they take?
items.explanation: One day's combined work = 1/12 + 1/15 = 9/60 = 3/20. Total days = 20/3 = 6 2/3 days.

items.stem: What is the least number that leaves a remainder of 3 when divided by 6, 9 and 15 each?
items.explanation: LCM of 6, 9 and 15 is 90. Adding the remainder 3 gives 90 + 3 = 93, which leaves remainder 3 on division by each of them.

items.stem: The speed of a boat in still water is 12 km/hr and the speed of the stream is 3 km/hr. How much time does the boat take to go 45 km upstream?
items.explanation: Upstream speed = 12 - 3 = 9 km/hr. Time = distance / speed = 45 / 9 = 5 hours.

items.stem: The price of an item is first increased by 20% and then decreased by 10%. What is the net change in the price of the item?
items.explanation: After a 20% rise the price is 120% of the original. A 10% fall on 120% gives 120 x 0.9 = 108%, which is a net increase of 8%.

items.stem: Find the simple interest on Rs. 8,000 for 2 years and 6 months at 5% per annum.
items.explanation: Time = 2.5 years. Simple interest = 8000 x 5 x 2.5 / 100 = Rs. 1,000.

items.stem: A shopkeeper buys a cycle for Rs. 1,400 and sells it for Rs. 1,540. What is his profit percentage?
items.explanation: Profit = 1540 - 1400 = 140. Profit percentage = (140 / 1400) x 100 = 10%.

items.stem: The perimeter of a square is 64 cm. What is the area of the square in square centimetres?
items.explanation: Side of the square = 64 / 4 = 16 cm. Area = 16 x 16 = 256 square centimetres.

items.stem: A 60-litre mixture contains milk and water in the ratio of 2 to 1. How much water must be added so that the mixture has milk and water in the ratio of 1 to 1?
items.explanation: Milk = 40 litres and water = 20 litres. For a 1 to 1 ratio, water must equal milk at 40 litres, so 40 - 20 = 20 litres of water are needed.

items.stem: Pointing to a photograph, Ram said, 'She is the daughter of my grandfather's only son.' How is the girl in the photograph related to Ram?
items.explanation: Ram's grandfather's only son is Ram's father. The daughter of Ram's father is Ram's sister, so the girl is his sister.

items.stem: A is the brother of B. C is the mother of A. D is the father of C. How is D related to A?
items.explanation: C is A's mother, and D is C's father, so D is the father of A's mother, that is A's maternal grandfather.

items.stem: Given that no table is a chair and that all chairs are wooden, which conclusion definitely follows? Conclusion I says that no table is wooden, and conclusion II says that some wooden things are chairs.
options: Both conclusions I and II follow
items.explanation: From 'All chairs are wooden' we get 'Some wooden things are chairs', so conclusion II follows. Conclusion I that no table is wooden does not follow from the given statements.

items.stem: In a certain code language, BANK is written as CBOL. How will TREE be written in that code?
items.explanation: Each letter is replaced by the next letter in the alphabet, so B becomes C, A becomes B, N becomes O and K becomes L. Applying the same rule, TREE becomes USFD.

items.stem: Find the next term in the number series 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ?
items.explanation: The differences are 3, 5, 7 and 9, increasing by 2 each time. The next difference is 11, so the next term is 27 + 11 = 38.

items.stem: In the English alphabet series, what is the 8th letter to the right of the 10th letter from the left end?
items.explanation: The 10th letter from the left is J. Counting 8 letters to the right of J gives R, the 18th letter of the alphabet.

items.stem: In a class of 40 students, Rahul ranks 15th from the top. What is his rank from the bottom of the class?
items.explanation: Rank from the bottom = total students - rank from top + 1 = 40 - 15 + 1 = 26th.

items.stem: If today is Monday, what day of the week will it be after 61 days?
items.explanation: 61 divided by 7 leaves a remainder of 5. Counting 5 days after Monday gives Saturday.

items.stem: Given that P is greater than Q, that Q is greater than or equal to R, and that R equals S, which conclusion is definitely true? Conclusion I states that P is greater than S, and conclusion II states that Q is greater than or equal to S.
options: Both conclusions I and II are true
items.explanation: Since P > Q >= R = S, P is definitely greater than S, so conclusion I holds. Also Q >= R and R = S means Q >= S, so conclusion II holds as well.

items.stem: Four of the following five words belong to the same group. Which one does NOT belong to that group?
items.explanation: Rose, Lotus and Marigold are all flowers, whereas Mango is a fruit, so it does not belong to the group of flowers.

items.stem: Ravi walks 4 km towards the east from his house and then turns left and walks 3 km. How far is he now from his house?
items.explanation: The eastward path and the left-turned northward path form the two legs of a right triangle. The distance from home is the square root of 4^2 + 3^2 = 25, which is 5 km.

items.stem: In a certain code language, CAT is written as DBU and DOG is written as EPH. How will MOUSE be written in that code?
items.explanation: Each letter is replaced by the next letter in the alphabet, so MOUSE becomes NPVTF when every letter moves one step forward.

items.stem: Given that some books are pens and that all pens are files, which conclusion definitely follows? Conclusion I says that some books are files, and conclusion II says that all files are pens.
items.explanation: Some books being pens and all pens being files means some books are files, so conclusion I follows. The reverse claim that all files are pens does not follow.

items.stem: Find the next term in the letter series AZ, BY, CX, DW, ?
items.explanation: The first letter advances one step each time (A, B, C, D, so next is E) and the second letter retreats one step (Z, Y, X, W, so next is V), giving EV.

items.stem: In a row of students, Priya is 12th from the left end and 18th from the right end. How many students are there in the row?
items.explanation: Total students = position from left + position from right - 1 = 12 + 18 - 1 = 29.

items.stem: Choose the word nearest in meaning to the word 'abundant' as used in the sentence, The region has abundant rainfall.
items.explanation: Abundant means existing in large quantities, so plentiful is the nearest synonym. Scarce, rare and sparse all mean the opposite.

items.stem: Choose the word nearest in OPPOSITE meaning to the word 'benevolent' as used in the sentence, The benevolent donor funded the school.
items.explanation: Benevolent means well-meaning and kindly, so its opposite is malevolent, meaning wishing harm. Kind, generous and charitable are all near synonyms.

items.stem: Identify the segment in the following sentence that contains a grammatical error. He do not like to drink coffee in the evening.
items.explanation: The subject 'He' is third person singular, so the auxiliary should be 'does', making the correct phrase 'He does not like'. The rest of the sentence is correct.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word. She has been working in this bank ____ 2015.
items.explanation: 'Since' is used with a point in time such as a year to mark the start of an action that continues to the present, while 'for' would need a period.

items.stem: What is the meaning of the idiom 'to keep one's fingers crossed'?
options: To count money again and again
To hope for a good outcome
items.explanation: The idiom 'keep one's fingers crossed' means to hope that something good will happen, especially while waiting for news about an uncertain result.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate verb form. The manager, as well as his subordinates, ____ present at the meeting.
items.explanation: When 'as well as' joins two subjects, the verb agrees with the first subject. 'The manager' is singular, so the correct form is 'was'.

items.stem: Choose the one-word substitution for a person who can use both the left and the right hand with equal skill.
items.explanation: Ambidextrous means able to use both hands equally well. Ambivalent means having mixed feelings, ambiguous means unclear, and ambulatory means able to walk.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate preposition. The manager congratulated the team ____ its success in the project.
items.explanation: The correct collocation is 'congratulate someone on something'. The preposition 'on' is standard after 'congratulated' in this context.

items.stem: Choose the option that gives the CORRECT spelling of the word as it is used in the sentence, The bank offered an a_____tion to borrowers.
items.explanation: The correct spelling is 'accommodation', which has double c and double m. The other options miss one of the doubled consonants.

items.stem: Read the passage and answer. The RBI is India's central bank. Its main role is to regulate monetary policy and maintain price stability, and it also supervises commercial banks. According to the passage, the RBI supervises commercial banks to ensure that
items.explanation: The passage states that the RBI supervises commercial banks so that the banking system remains sound, which is the option that matches the text.

items.stem: Choose the word nearest in OPPOSITE meaning to the word 'transient' as used in the sentence, The pain was only transient.
items.explanation: Transient means lasting only a short time, so its opposite is permanent. Brief, fleeting and passing are all near synonyms of transient.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word. Neither the manager nor the employees ____ satisfied with the new policy.
items.explanation: With 'neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject. 'Employees' is plural, so the correct form is 'were'.

items.stem: Change the voice of the following sentence to the passive form. The committee has approved the proposal.
options: The proposal was approved by the committee.
The proposal is approved by the committee.
The proposal has been approved by the committee.
The proposal had been approved by the committee.
items.explanation: The sentence is in the present perfect tense, so its passive form is 'has been' plus the past participle, giving 'The proposal has been approved by the committee'.

items.stem: Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word. If I ____ you, I would accept the offer without hesitation.
items.explanation: This is a second conditional sentence about an unreal present situation, so the subjunctive form 'were' is used for every subject.

items.stem: What is the meaning of the idiom 'a wild goose chase'?
options: A long walk in the countryside
items.explanation: The idiom 'a wild goose chase' describes a hopeless, futile pursuit or search for something that cannot be found, not an actual hunt.

items.stem: In Indian banking, what does the abbreviation CRR stand for?
items.explanation: CRR stands for Cash Reserve Ratio, the share of a bank's deposits that it must keep with the Reserve Bank of India.

items.stem: Which institution is responsible for formulating monetary policy in India?
options: Securities and Exchange Board of India
items.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India, as the central bank, formulates and implements India's monetary policy through instruments such as the repo rate and CRR.

items.stem: The headquarters of the Reserve Bank of India is located in which city?
items.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India has its headquarters in Mumbai, the financial capital of India.

items.stem: In Indian banking, what does the abbreviation SLR stand for?
items.explanation: SLR stands for Statutory Liquidity Ratio, the minimum share of deposits that banks must maintain in liquid assets such as cash, gold or approved securities.

items.stem: Which of the following institutions is the apex body for agricultural and rural credit in India?
items.explanation: NABARD, the National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development, is the apex institution for agricultural and rural refinance in India.

items.stem: In Indian banking, what does the abbreviation NEFT stand for?
items.explanation: NEFT stands for National Electronic Fund Transfer, a nationwide payment system that settles funds in batches on a net basis.

items.stem: How many members are there in the Monetary Policy Committee of India?
items.explanation: The Monetary Policy Committee has six members, made up of three officials of the Reserve Bank of India and three experts nominated by the central government.

items.stem: What is the repo rate in the context of Indian monetary policy?
options: The rate at which the RBI lends short-term funds to commercial banks
The rate at which commercial banks lend to their customers
The rate at which banks lend to each other in the interbank market
The rate at which the RBI borrows funds from commercial banks
items.explanation: The repo rate is the rate at which the Reserve Bank of India lends short-term money to commercial banks against government securities, and it is a key policy rate.

items.stem: Under the DICGC deposit insurance framework in India, deposits are insured up to what amount per depositor per bank?
items.explanation: The Deposit Insurance and Credit Guarantee Corporation insures bank deposits up to Rs. 5 lakh per depositor per bank, covering principal and interest.

items.stem: In banking terminology, what does the abbreviation NPA stand for?
items.explanation: NPA stands for Non-Performing Asset, a loan or advance on which interest or principal has not been received for a specified period, usually 90 days.

items.stem: What is a cheque in the context of banking?
options: An oral promise by a customer to repay a loan
A long-term loan sanctioned by a bank
A government bond issued to raise public funds
A written order from an account holder directing the bank to pay a specified sum
items.explanation: A cheque is a written instrument by which an account holder instructs the bank to pay a certain sum from the account, either to a person or to order.

items.stem: Which of the following is a core function of the Reserve Bank of India?
items.explanation: The Reserve Bank of India has the sole right to issue currency notes in India, except one-rupee notes which are issued by the Ministry of Finance.

items.stem: In Indian finance, what does the acronym FEMA stand for?
items.explanation: FEMA stands for the Foreign Exchange Management Act, the law that governs foreign exchange transactions and current account convertibility in India.

items.stem: What does the term 'financial inclusion' mean in the Indian banking context?
options: Merging all banks into a single state-owned bank
Restricting banking services to wealthy customers only
Ensuring access to useful and affordable financial services for all sections of society
Closing bank branches in rural and remote areas
items.explanation: Financial inclusion means that individuals and businesses have access to useful and affordable financial products and services such as payments, savings, credit and insurance.

items.stem: Which year is used as the base year for the calculation of Gross Domestic Product in India's official national accounts?
items.explanation: India's official GDP series uses 2011-12 as the base year for measuring growth at constant prices, as adopted by the National Statistical Commission.
